_doc: standard recipe: ONE constant set per source, no scene values. Rules: train/recipe/recipe_rules.py, docs/recipe.md. Change a constant only after the Gegenprobe on every scene of its source (tolerance -0.1 dB / +5 % rate).

budget._doc: only when a delivery rate target is given: contrib ranking scored on EVERY frame, then the kept splats are fine-tuned again (prune -> fine-tune), then the same clean encode

images._doc: near plane 0.9 x min camera near (LLFF) else 0.1 x min camera distance; random background + alpha loss whenever the GT has a matte; init regularisers the same for every scene
images.train_env: P15_EXPO_LEARN=1e-3 P15_NEARPRUNE=1.0 E7_K=5 E7_SOFT_KNOT0=1 E7_CURV=3e-5 E7_CURV_ATTRS=means,quats,scales,sh0 E7_GROW=0.0004 E7_L=32 E7_REFRESH=8 E7_ITS=15000 E7_SEED=0 E7_STATIC_LR=0.3

mesh._doc: sample spacing h = spacing_px x pixel footprint at the median camera distance of the figures; per mesh the spacing never drops below 1 px at its closest camera distance (replaces max-per-model / --cap-owner); far + static meshes go to their own stream (backdrop); the P42 v2 splat fix is always on
mesh._fix_doc: --thin-open 3 = thin open meshes (decals, w = 2A/P_open < 3h) sampled at w/3 (floor 0.5 px at their closest camera) and at their largest size, --thin-aniso their splats follow the deformation gradient, --thin-inset 1.0 no samples closer than 1 sigma to their open edge (the Gaussian rim lies ~0.72 sigma outside); --ontop = <geom>/flags.json (ba3_export.py flags) depthTest-off meshes moved in front of their occluders along the film camera rays (dropped when the scene has no flags.json)
